# CellEmergence

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The spontaneous formation of bounded, self-sustaining regions (cells) from a continuous field, driven by local nonlinear interactions. Enables bottom-up construction of computational primitives in topology-centric networks without predefined routing or fixed logic.
